New in this update:
• Assignment types: Practical, Lab report, Project, Presentation, Quiz and more, each with its own icon
• Automatic numbering per subject: the next Surgery practical after Practical 4 becomes Practical 5 (turn it off in Settings → Assignments)
• Group assignments by due date, subject or type, on both the To do and Done tabs
• Compact assignment cards in each subject's colour; tap one to see its details
• Add a new subject right from the assignment form, without creating any classes for it
• Add the course instructor to an assignment; the app learns who sets work for each subject and fills it in for you
• Types, numbers and instructors are included in backups
